title: Special permit for Studio 54 rehabilitation, Manhattan
summary: This land use application grants Roundabout Theatre Company a special permit to add about 187,783 square feet of bonus floor area in exchange for rehabilitating the historic Studio 54 theater at 254 West 54th Street in Manhattan. It is tied to a related zoning text amendment and is subject to an environmental review finding no significant impact. The Council approved the City Planning Commission's decision on November 12, 2026.
